title: The batch gate keeps a batch whose only failure is a check with an open flaky item
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: with an open "Flaky check on main: e2e:smoke" item, a landing that fails smoke on the tip is not reverted; the failure is recorded on the flaky item, the tip verifies and the deploy watch serves it, and master status names the flaky item.

steps.name: Gate a batch whose only failure has an open flaky item through the real loop
